en: A black‑and‑white panoramic view over a hilly European town with dense clusters of pitched‑roof houses, tree‑lined streets, small industrial buildings with chimneys in the foreground, and several prominent church spires rising from the center and upper ridge. The surrounding landscape shows terraced gardens and wooded hills. No visible decorative borders or captioning text appear on the image side.
